lead: `docs/novis.md` is generated from the built binary, so regenerating before rebuilding writes nothing and says "unchanged".
body: `python tools/reference.py --no-examples` reads `nvs meta --json` out of `target/debug/nvs.exe`, which is true of the binary and false of the tree after a source edit. The order is `python tools/verify.py` (which rebuilds), then regenerate, then `--check`.
